embeddings.title: Embeddings (RAG workshop)
embeddings.hint: Model used to index the workshops' PDF sources and search them. It is a separate model from the chat model above.
embeddings.autoPull: Automatically install the model at startup if missing
embeddings.topKHint: Higher = the AI sees more passages per question (better for broad questions like "list the…"), but a longer prompt. Default 8. With a large-context model (Gemini), you can go up to 50-150 for near "whole document" coverage. For exhaustive questions, prefer the workshop's "Deep analysis" button.
embeddings.mistralKeyHint: This is the same key as for the Mistral chat (a single shared key). Subject to the free tier's rate limit.

context.title: Context window
context.hintKnown: The {{model}} model accepts up to {{max}} tokens. The higher the value, the more history and context the AI can hold — at the cost of VRAM and latency.
context.hintUnknown: Unable to determine the model's max window (Ollama unreachable or unknown model). Slider capped at {{max}} as a safeguard.

pdf.title: PDF import
pdf.chunkTokensHint:
When importing a PDF (rules or campaign), the text is split into chunks of this size before being analyzed by the AI. Bigger = fewer chunks, so faster and less fragmentation/duplication — but the chunk must fit within the model's window.
Reference: ~10,000 for Ollama (16k context); up to ~100,000 for a large-context model (e.g. GPT-5 mini, 400k) to process a whole book in one pass. Caution: a big chunk = longer generation (see the timeout below).
pdf.timeoutHint: Maximum wait time for a model response. If a heavy import fails with "timeout", increase this value (e.g. 600) or reduce the chunk size above. Default: 300 s.
